fact: Loi n° 18-019 of 9 July 2018 on payment systems and securities settlement systems was enacted and published in the Journal Officiel of 23 July 2018, and defines electronic money and payment orders.
system: Loi n° 18-019 relative aux systèmes de paiement et de règlement-titres

fact: Banque Centrale du Congo Instruction No. 58 of 4 September 2024 obliges regulated entities, among them credit institutions, financial companies, postal services and aggregators, to connect to the National E-Payment Switch within six months, under sanction.

The Banque Centrale du Congo's map of the national payment system lists the payment service providers it has approved, among them five financial companies including e-money issuers and 81 money-transfer firms, as at end-2023.
